scene_timeline.audio_description: A male voice (Alan Watts) asks, "Do you know how long you've been here?" The younger man replies, "No." The voice continues, "Weeks. Months. Do you know why you're here?"

scene_timeline.audio_description: The male voice (Alan Watts) states, "Man is a little jug that lives on an unimportant rock ball..."
